description.fun: Litwick shines a light and pretends to be a helpful guide, but it's quietly leeching the life force of anyone who follows, and that life is what fuels its flame. It is said to take lost children by the hand to lead them to the spirit world. The younger the life it absorbs, the brighter and eerier its flame burns. Its Japanese name means 'lighting a lamp', a phrase also used for the torchbearer who leads a funeral procession.
description.guide: Litwick is a Ghost- and Fire-type candle Pokémon that absorbs life energy to fuel the flame on its head. It evolves into Lampent, then Chandelure with a Dusk Stone.
description.tagline: A cute candle that lights the way to the spirit world.

description.fun: Lampent appears just before someone passes away and absorbs the spirit as it leaves the body, so it's feared as an emissary of death. It lurks in cities pretending to be a street lamp, hangs around hospitals, and quietly trails anyone whose death is near. The spirits it takes fuel its baleful fire. Its name mixes 'lamp', 'lambent' and perhaps 'lament', and its lampshade looks a bit like a witch's hat.
description.guide: Lampent is the evolved form of Litwick, a Ghost- and Fire-type lamp Pokémon said to absorb the spirits of the dying. It evolves into Chandelure with a Dusk Stone.
description.tagline: A ghostly street lamp that waits for the dying.

description.fun: Chandelure haunts run-down mansions and sways its arms to hypnotise foes with its dancing flames. Those flames don't burn the body; they burn the spirit, leaving the body behind, and spirits burned in them are said to wander this world forever. Homes lit by Chandelure instead of lamps supposedly saw funeral after funeral. Fans voted it the most popular Generation V Pokémon in the 2020 Pokémon of the Year poll.
description.guide: Chandelure is the final form of Litwick, a Ghost- and Fire-type chandelier Pokémon that hypnotises foes and absorbs their spirits. It can Mega Evolve into Mega Chandelure.
description.tagline: A haunted chandelier whose flames burn spirits, not bodies.

description.fun: Mega Evolution turns it into a grander, two-tiered chandelier crowned with a towering purple flame. One of its eyes turns purple and becomes a window between our world and the afterlife, and it draws in the hatred around it and converts it into power, spinning like a chandelier before it attacks.
